players.product: PCIe Gen6 fabric switches (Scorpio), retimers (Aries), AECs (Torus), CXL memory controllers (Leo) for AI racks

quarterly_data.quarter: Astera Labs press release: Astera Labs Bolsters Leo Smart Memory Controller Family for (09-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Astera Labs announced three new Leo Smart Memory Controllers: Leo X-Series, a fabric-attached memory controller paired with Scorpio X-Series fabric switches for KV-cache offload (company figures: up to 62% faster time to first token and up to 22% more tokens per second), and Leo 2 E-Series (CPU-attached CXL 3.2 memory expansion over PCIe 6 x16) and P-Series (CXL memory pooling and sharing, dual-port PCIe 6 x8), which support four DDR4 or DDR5 memory controllers and double memory bandwidth and capacity versus the previous generation, including reuse of previously deployed DDR4 DIMMs. The family is sampling today with hyperscaler customers and, per the company, is driving new design wins across AI labs, hyperscale and neocloud customers (not named). Developed in collaboration with AMD, Arm, Intel and major memory suppliers.
quarterly_data.figure: Leo X-Series and Leo 2 E/P-Series sampling with hyperscaler customers; up to 62% faster TTFT, up to 22% more TPS
